programs.title: Over The Top
programs.desc: A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

programs.title: Running Scared
programs.desc: Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal in this comedy thriller that asks the question, "How come the bad guys always drive the good cars?"

programs.title: The Mod Squad
programs.desc: Julie (Claire Danes), Pete (Giovanni Ribisi) and Linc (Omar Epps) are three problem teens headed to jail...until Captain Greer (Dennis Farina) offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene. It’s a case that the cops can’t crack, but when Greer sends in his new task force – The Mod Squad – they quickly uncover a crime ring involving drugs, hookers...and dirty cops!

programs.title: Dillinger
programs.desc: Starring Warren Oates, Ben Johnson, Cloris Leachman and Richard Dreyfuss, this electrifying crime saga about one of the most notorious gangsters of the 1930's sets the screen ablaze with explosive shootouts, daring escapes and stellar performances.

programs.title: Mulholland Falls
programs.desc: In the 1950s, an elite squad of detectives becomes embroiled in a conspiracy and faces a secret the U.S. government is determined to keep hidden.

programs.title: King Solomon's Mines (1985)
programs.desc: Experience wild stunts, romance and heart-pounding excitement with Richard Chamberlain as a soldier of fortune who unwittingly gets tied into a young woman's (Sharon Stone) search for her missing father. Herbert Lom and John Rhys-Davies also star.
